title: Interaction I had with a university nurse (in Mall World)
content: I was falling in and out of consciousness (in the dream) walking through corridors of a university, and a nurse saw me and walked me to a bedroom. She told me to rest, and I fell asleep (in the dream) and had a dream about the singer Rihanna standing in sand dunes. I woke up (in the same university dorm bed), and the nurse was there again, checking my vitals. She offered me water and asked me to visit the infirmary later, so that she could more thoroughly check on me. I fell back asleep there in bed, and woke up in my own bedroom.
